day_shape: 67 items: Netanyahu-Katz regime-change rhetoric and FT report of a cancelled Oct 10 Israeli strike on Iran blocked by Trump, fresh OFAC designations on a Greek/Panama law firm, explosions reported at Sirik, and an executive order implementing the Graham Russia-Iran Sanctions Act.

threads.label: Israeli strike plans and regime-change rhetoric
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel reported Netanyahu had planned Israeli strikes on Iran around 10 October before Trump objected ahead of the US midterms, with Defence Minister Katz saying 'Iran will burn'. Netanyahu told the Post Iran and its proxies may try to interfere in Israel's elections and accused Mojtaba Khamenei of resuming weapons development.

threads.label: US sanctions and enforcement on Iran trade
threads.summary: OFAC sanctioned a Greek law firm, a Panama firm, shipping operators and maritime logistics companies accused of helping Iran evade oil-export restrictions, per Iran International and Jerusalem Post. A Federal Register notice implemented the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, and Canada's Immigration and Refugee Board ordered deportation of an Iranian man over sanctions evasion.

threads.label: Iran diplomatic posture: Russia, China, US
threads.summary: Iran International reported Putin discussed Iran with US envoy Steve Witkoff after Lavrov's Tehran visit, while IRIB questioned whether Russia had 'betrayed' Iran over a Moscow-Washington deal. Defa Press said China's ambassador met deputy foreign minister Gharibabadi, and Araghchi warned the US that choosing war over diplomacy would bring a 'strategic defeat'.

threads.label: Hormuz, undersea cables and Sirik explosions
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post cited Iranian media reporting explosions in Sirik, while Iran International examined the IRGC's threat to undersea cables in the Strait of Hormuz. Khamenei's office posted that 'foreigners' coveting the Persian Gulf 'have no place there except at the depths of its waters', and IRIB amplified an Al Jazeera claim about an internet 'kill switch'.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes and election-period operations
threads.summary: The IDF announced the killing of Nukhba operative Musa Abd Muhammad Hamouda in Gaza City, plus a PIJ rocket operative and a Hamas sniper in Daraj-Tuffah strikes on Monday. A Walla security source said operations in Gaza had intensified over two weeks over concerns about disruption to Israel's elections, with troops voting from south Lebanon and offshore.

threads.label: Iran's regional border and Kurdish operations
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Iraq closed one of its southern border crossings with Iran amid US pressure on Baghdad, and that Iran struck a site linked to the Kurdistan Freedom Party in the Balisan Valley near Erbil. Defa Press and IRIB carried Sisi's statement that Egyptian military movements aim solely to defend Saudi territory and do not include attacking Yemen.

threads.label: Qalibaf-Mojtaba Khamenei meeting and internal politics
threads.summary: Khamenei's office, IRIB and Defa Press announced that Majlis Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf met Ayatollah Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei to review 'military, economic and cognitive warfare of the American-Zionist enemy'. Jerusalem Post separately reported Qalibaf spoke with Mojtaba Khamenei on Wednesday.

events.title_en: China's ambassador meets with Araghchi
events.summary_en: China's ambassador in Tehran met today (Wednesday, 29 Mehr) with Kazem Gharibabadi, Deputy for Legal and International Affairs at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, for talks and discussions. In the meeting with China's ambassador, discussions and exchanges of views took place regarding strengthening cooperation and coordination between the two countries in defence of national sovereignty, respect for international law, countering unilateralism, and threats to regional peace and security. Both Iran and China emphasise the necessity of developing cooperation among the Global South. This meeting comes two days after Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov's visit to Tehran and one day after Pakistani Army Commander Asim Munir's visit, whose country is mediating between Iran
